clips.label: The Night Orchard · 1 minute 56 seconds
clips.note: An amber pear leads through floating orchards, a dark sea and a glass garden, returning to silver trees at dawn.
clips.details:
The liked opening continues into hanging roots, water, a glass garden, suspended seeds and a rooted silver tree. Amber light and branching forms connect the scenes. Fine details redraw; the passage beneath the water is a visual morph, and the glass garden later reads as a night landscape. Silver boughs frame the final tree as morning light arrives.

Silent 116-second cut. Native 1536×1024 paintings, 24 fps. The original 48 paintings are preserved with 300 new paintings; the complete 120-second generation remains archived. Krea recurrent repaints use CFG 1, three Euler intervals and recorded independent seeds. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 fills the intervals outside generation; the last seven frames continue the actual camera warp.

clips.label: Original short · 16 seconds
clips.note: One amber pear becomes an orchard among the stars.
clips.details:
A midnight greenhouse, a silver branch and one amber pear lead into a suspended orchard. The final drift reveals the islands and their roots. The transition is a visual transformation; the fruit does not perform a literal hinged opening. Fine leaves, bark and architecture redraw along the way.

Silent first cut. Native 1536×1024 paintings. Same-model Krea opening and recurrent repainting, CFG 1, three Euler intervals, recorded fresh seeds. Forty-eight paintings retained at three paintings per displayed second. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 fills the intervals outside generation; the final seven frames continue the camera warp. Sixteen seconds at 24 fps.
